scenes.title: Your mortgage offer, explained
scenes.narration: Hi Sophie. This short video explains your mortgage offer from Fernmoor. It takes about two minutes. You can pause, turn on captions, or ask a question at any time.

scenes.title: What you're borrowing
scenes.narration: You're borrowing £297,500 to buy a home worth £350,000. That's 85 percent of its value. Lenders call this your loan to value. You'll pay it back over 35 years.
scenes.speech: You're borrowing £297,500 to buy a home worth £350,000. That's 85 percent of its value. Lenders call this your loan to value. You'll pay it back over 35 years.

scenes.title: Your fixed rate
scenes.narration: For the first 2 years, your rate is fixed at 5.09 percent. Your monthly payment stays at £1,518.57, even if interest rates change.
scenes.speech: For the first 2 years, your rate is fixed at 5.09 percent. Your monthly payment stays at £1,518.57, even if interest rates change.

scenes.title: When your fixed rate ends
scenes.narration: Your fixed rate ends on 30 November 2028. After that, you move to our Standard Variable Rate. It's 7.49 percent today, and it can go up or down. If it stays the same, your payment would rise to £1,985.46 a month. That's £466.89 more. Many people choose a new deal before their fixed rate ends.

scenes.title: Paying off early

visual.footnote: Overpay up to 10% a year with no charge.

scenes.narration: You can pay off up to 10 percent of what you owe each year at no extra cost. If you repay more than that during your fixed rate, there's an early repayment charge. It's 3 percent in year 1 and 2 percent in year 2. For example, repaying an extra ten thousand pounds in year 1 would cost £300.

scenes.title: Fees
scenes.narration: There's a product fee of £1,499.00. You pay it when your mortgage completes. It isn't added to your loan.

scenes.title: The total cost
scenes.narration: Over the full 35 years, you'd repay about £824,186 in total, if rates don't change. That includes your loan of £297,500 and the interest on it.

items: Keep your home insured for its full rebuild cost

scenes.narration: There are a few things you need to do. Keep up your payments. Your home may be repossessed if you don't. Keep your home insured. And remember, this offer is valid until 1 April 2027.
